build: ARM64 Release; isolated worktree; excludes concurrent main-worktree features
method: CPU0 probe; IPC peer CPU0/1; controlled services CPU2; temperature CPU3; two warmups and seven retained batches; nearest-rank individual tails
limits: CPU0-wide PMU counts include other tasks and IRQs; exclude CPU1/2 work and include read overhead
Pinned diagnostic service layout is not production scheduling policy
No statistical confidence bound or universal improvement claim; slower IPC observations retained, version attribution unresolved
Thermal stress is bounded single-core work, with debugger sampling; no four-core long-duration validation
No firmware clock/throttling-flag readings and no x64/RISC-V validation

runs.error:
/rpi-perf.elf em024 1 pmu; echo RPI_COMMAND_STATUS=$?
RPI_PERF_ERROR arguments
RPI_COMMAND_STATUS=1
moss$

thermal.scope: single-core repeated 1 MiB copies; temperature sampling halts idle CPU3; not a throughput benchmark

final_hardware_state.pmu_option: OFF in the frozen production build
final_hardware_state.source_scope: isolated performance worktree; concurrent monitor/top excluded

host_validation.scope: After narrow integration into main; no full rebuild of concurrent main features
